dct_title_s: Damage assessment around the chemical factory, Samut Prakan Province, Thailand
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: AC20210705THA** This map illustrates the damage assessment after the blast of the 5th July 2021 in Bang Phli Yai sub-district, Bang Phli district, Samut Prakan province, Thailand. UNITAR - UNOSAT identified 328 potentially damaged structures of which 13 are destroyed and 315 are severely or moderately damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
